basic_info.description: Welcome to 1630 Sloat Blvd, San Francisco, CA - a refined residence offering an exceptional living experience. This expansive 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home spans 2,766 square feet and has been thoughtfully refreshed to meet contemporary standards while retaining its classic charm. Upon entering, you are greeted by an abundance of natural light that enhances the home's great flow. The main level features a second primary suite, providing flexibility and convenience for multi-generational living or guest accommodations. The large owner's retreat offers a serene space for relaxation, complete with ample closet space and a well-appointed en-suite bathroom.The property's prime location ensures easy access to a variety of amenities. Enjoy leisurely strolls to Lakeshore Plaza for shopping and dining, or take advantage of the proximity to Lake Merced for outdoor activities. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the nearby Harding Park Golf Course, while nature lovers can explore the scenic trails of Stern Grove. The vibrant West Portal neighborhood is also just a short distance away, offering additional shopping, dining, and entertainment options.Whether you are seeking a spacious home or a versatile property with multiple living arrangements,1630 Sloat Blvd is an excellent choice.
